# What passNavigation cannot lower is refused where it is written, on a target
# that does not declare `navigation`, rather than emitted wrong.
#
# A stack written directly under a `for` would be one current page and one
# history shared by every copy, since its state is the owner's; written in a
# component the loop renders, each copy is an instance with its own.
#
# A `go` names its page by the page's own handle, which is what the lowering
# turns into the page's record. A page handed in as a value names a page the
# lowering cannot see from the call.

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:7:16: a nav.stack under a `for` would be one stack for every copy; write it in a component the loop renders'

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out value.sngl
stderr 'value.sngl:9:25: pages.go names its page through a value; name the page''s own #id'

-- loop.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Loop") {
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = [1, 2] {
            nav.stack #pages {
                nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                    ui.text(value="{i}")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- value.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window(title="Value") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.button(text="Home", @click {
                var p = home
                pages.go(p)
            })
        }
    }
}
